thread:
alex: Quick handoff from me — leaving the night shift. Short status below, tagging @maria and @tim.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert INC-452 triggered — embed-service returning 5xxs in us-west1. Spike started ~00:12 UTC.

maria: What I did — scaled embed-service to 5 replicas, restarted `kvproxy` on gke-prod-2, and flipped traffic to the small model variant for `/generate` (temp mitigation).

```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deployment embed-service --replicas=5
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment kvproxy
```

tim: Blockers — kvcache evictions still high, seeing OOM kills on kvproxy. snippet from kube logs: `oom_kill: pid=1234 comm=kvproxy`. Memory usage trending up even after restart.

alex: Mitigation applied — rolled kvproxy image back to `kvproxy:v1.3.2` (previous stable), enabled soft LRU eviction (config flag `--cache-soft-limit=0.75`). Created PR with autoscaler tweak: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/1024

jess: Next steps from my side — keep the small-model fallback for the next 45m, monitor request_error_rate and p95 latency. If error rate > 2.5% for 5m, escalate to infra pager. I also set a temp dashboard and alert.

maria: On monitoring — dashboards updated (link: https://grafana.internal/d/ops/embed-ops). Alert threshold set to 2.5% for request_error_rate. I'll keep an eye on heap profiles and will collect `pmap` if it recurs.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout to small-model variant completed to 10% traffic — :white_check_mark:. No regressions observed in canary slice.

alex: Leaving detailed notes in the incident ticket (INC-452). If nothing flares up by 01:30 UTC, we can revert to normal model routing and scale down to 3 replicas. I'm reachable on DM until 01:00. :thumbsup:

jess: Thanks — I'm taking watch for the next hour. ping me in thread for any sudden increase. :eyes:
